game.title.description: Name of the Star Swarm game card.
game.title.notes: Do not translate the game name.

game.description.description: One-line description on the Star Swarm game card.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Star Swarm play button.

game.canvasLabel.description: Accessible label for the game canvas — describes game and interaction.

hud.score.description: Short uppercase label for the current score in the HUD.

hud.best.description: Short uppercase label for the high score in the HUD.

hud.wave.description: Short uppercase label for the current wave number in the HUD.

phase.waveClear.description: Overlay text shown for a moment when the player clears a wave.

phase.freeFireZone.description: Overlay text shown at the start of a bonus Free Fire Zone wave.

phase.hits.description: Sub-line during Free Fire Zone showing how many enemies the player has hit.

phase.perfectBonus.description: Line under PERFECT! during the celebration pause after a perfect Free Fire Zone clear, showing the bonus points awarded.

phase.perfectAnnouncement.description: Screen-reader announcement when the player hits every ship in a Free Fire Zone.
phase.perfectAnnouncement.notes: {{count}} is the number of ships in the Free Fire Zone (an integer, currently 40). {{points}} is a pre-formatted number (e.g. 10,000).

phase.gameOver.description: Large overlay text when the player loses all lives.

score.display.description: Accessibility label for the score display.

controls.chargeShotLabel.description: Accessibility label for the charge shot button.

controls.paused.description: Large text shown in the pause overlay.

controls.tapToResume.description: Hint text under the PAUSED heading — instructs user to tap to resume.

controls.resumeLabel.description: Accessibility label for the pause-overlay resume pressable.

controls.newGame.description: Label on the new-game button shown on the game-over screen.

controls.newGameLabel.description: Accessibility label for the new-game button.

a11y.carrierExposed.description: Screen-reader announcement when the last Boss escort dies and the Carrier's force field drops, so it can now be damaged by ordinary shots.
a11y.carrierExposed.notes: Carrier is the large top-row enemy ship added in #2484.

a11y.carrierBeam.description: Screen-reader announcement when the Carrier starts charging its sweep beam; the player has about 0.6 s to move out of the column below it.
a11y.carrierBeam.notes: Carrier is the large top-row enemy ship (#2484); the beam is #2485.

a11y.reinforcements.description: Screen-reader announcement when the Carrier launches replacement grunts into the formation.

hud.guns.description: HUD label before the gun level number (1–3). Rendered as e.g. 'GUNS L2'.

hud.hull.description: HUD label before the hull plating pips.

a11y.gunsUp.description: Screen-reader cue after collecting a salvage crate.

a11y.gunsDown.description: Screen-reader cue when a lost life drops the gun level.

a11y.hullUp.description: Screen-reader cue after collecting hull plating.

a11y.hullHit.description: Screen-reader cue when hull plating absorbs a hit instead of a life.
